limits: All numerical values are conditional elastic frame estimates.

vacuum_reference.ledger_note: Outgassing changes phase of existing vehicle mass. Only net external ingress adds mass. Passive getters retain external gas; pumping can remove it. The 48.894 kg free-gas operating criterion is reported separately from net added mass.
